doctrine: Name the shadow. Never steal its payload. Public nodes are resources. Private nodes are reminders to legally check the public links around them. LYGO crunches public data into usable infrastructure from every honest angle — not malice.

nodes.label: USGS earthquake feed
nodes.why: Public seismic catalog. If the GET fails, the node still exists — check the public URL.

nodes.label: NASA EONET events
nodes.why: Public natural-event index. Unreachable ≠ invented fires.

nodes.label: NWS active alerts
nodes.why: US public weather alerts. If the GET fails, the NWS node still exists.

nodes.label: GDACS disaster events
nodes.why: EU/UN public disaster awareness. Named even when quiet.

nodes.label: RainViewer public radar mosaic
nodes.why: 1200+ public radars, 5-minute mosaic. Educational/personal use. Not a classified NEXRAD interior.

nodes.label: Global public weather alerts
nodes.why: LibreWXR aggregates public WMO/CAP-style alerts. Polygons are public. Internal forecast desks stay shadow.

nodes.label: Meteoalarm MQTT / token API
nodes.why: European warning broker exists; the token MQTT is not a public GET. Use LibreWXR/NWS/DWD public faces instead.

nodes.label: HF Public Witness overlay
nodes.why: Hugging Face Space aggregates public GETs so CORS-blocked browsers still get a labeled RESOURCE feed. Failures stay named shadows.

nodes.label: ISS public telemetry
nodes.why: Where-the-ISS-at is a public satellite. Not a classified feed.

nodes.label: Flight ops rooms
nodes.why: Airline and military dispatch exist. Passenger lists, cockpit intent, and internal tracks do not belong here. Check public ADS-B and airport notices.

nodes.label: Ship ops / cargo desks
nodes.why: Ports and fleets have private manifests. Public AIS and port notices are the legal check.

nodes.label: Operator ephemeris desks
nodes.why: Precision classified or commercial orbits stay inside operators. Public TLEs and the ISS overlay are the checkable shell.

nodes.label: Keyed fire products
nodes.why: Some FIRMS layers need keys. The public EONET wildfire list is the free angle.

nodes.label: Newsroom wires
nodes.why: Private wires exist. We do not scrape 500 outlets into fake certainty. Check what actually published.

nodes.label: Private intel vendors
nodes.why: Paid fusion rooms exist. Their contents are not ours. Public contracts, FOIA, and press are the legal perimeter.

nodes.label: Steward / agent vaults
nodes.why: Private vaults and meta_private eggs exist on the lattice. Public dual ledgers, egg retrieval pages, and Star Chart feed are the checkable face. No payload here.

nodes.label: Live Star Chart write path
nodes.why: The ingest door exists. This Witness never walks through it. Human consent + lygo-haven-star-chart only.

nodes.label: Private order books
nodes.why: Prediction and trading desks have private flow. Public settlement prices and news are the usable angle.
